exercises.instructionEn: Irregular Verbs — Infinitive / Past / Past Participle
exercises.explanationUz:
UCh USTUN NIMANI ANGLATADI:

  1-USTUN — INFINITIVE (asosiy shakl)
     Present Simple, modal fe'llardan keyin,
     'to' bilan.
        'I GO to school.'
        'You must GO.'
        'I want TO GO.'

  2-USTUN — PAST (2-shakl, V2)
     PAST SIMPLE zamonda.
        'I WENT to school yesterday.'

  3-USTUN — PAST PARTICIPLE (3-shakl, V3)
     PRESENT PERFECT da (have/has + V3)
     va majhul nisbatda.
        'I HAVE GONE.'
        'The car WAS BROKEN.'


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  'DID' va 'DIDN'T' dan keyin — 1-ShAKL!
     'I WENT.'         ✓ (2-shakl)
     'Did you GO?'     ✓ (1-shakl)
     'Did you WENT?'   ✗
     'I didn't GO.'    ✓
     'I didn't WENT.'  ✗

  'HAVE/HAS' dan keyin — 3-ShAKL!
     'I have GONE.'    ✓
     'I have WENT.'    ✗


UCh ASOSIY NAMUNA:

  1) A-A-A — UChALA ShAKL BIR XIL (13 ta):
     cost — cost — cost
     cut — cut — cut
     hit — hit — hit
     hurt — hurt — hurt
     let — let — let
     put — put — put
     set — set — set
     shut — shut — shut
     split — split — split
     spread — spread — spread
     burst — burst — burst
     read — read — read (⚠ TALAFFUZ
        o'zgaradi: /riːd/ → /red/ → /red/)
     beat — beat — beatEN (2 ta bir xil)

  2) A-B-B — 2 va 3-ShAKL BIR XIL
     (eng katta guruh):
     buy — bought — bought
     have — had — had
     make — made — made
     say — said — said
     ...

  3) A-B-C — UChALA ShAKL BOShQA:
     go — went — gone
     see — saw — seen
     do — did — done
     write — wrote — written
     ...


⚠ QAVSDAGI ShAKLLAR:

  Ba'zi fe'llarda IKKI shakl bor:

     burn  — burnt (burned)
     dream — dreamt (dreamed)
     learn — learnt (learned)
     smell — smelt (smelled)
     spell — spelt (spelled)

     BIRINChISI — Britaniya inglizchasi
     QAVSDAGISI — Amerika inglizchasi

  Boshqa qavslar BOShQA MA'NO uchun:

     hang — hung (HANGED)
        hung = osilgan (narsa)
        hanged = osib o'ldirilgan (odam)

     bear — bore — born(E)
        born = tug'ilgan
        borne = ko'tarilgan, chidalgan

     sew — sewed — sewn (SEWED)
     show — showed — shown


⚠ 'CAN' — MAXSUS HOLAT:
  can — could — (been able to)

  'can' ning haqiqiy 3-shakli YO'Q!
  Uning o'rniga 'BE ABLE TO' ishlatiladi:

     hozir:   'I CAN swim.'
     o'tmish: 'I COULD swim.'
     kelajak: 'I WILL BE ABLE TO swim.'
     Perfect: 'I HAVE BEEN ABLE TO swim.'

  ⚠ 'will can' — XATO!
  (113-bet: 'They will not BE ABLE TO
   understand.')


⚠ EN QIYIN JUFTLIK — LIE va LAY:

  Jadvalda IKKALASI ham bor:

     LIE — LAY — LAIN
        = yotmoq (o'zi yotadi)
        'I LIE on the bed.'
        'I LAY on the bed yesterday.'

     LAY — LAID — LAID
        = qo'ymoq, yotqizmoq (nimanidir)
        'I LAY the book on the table.'
        'I LAID the book on the table.'

  ⚠ Chalkashtirmang: 'lie' ning O'TMIShI
  ham 'LAY'!

  ⚠ Jadvalda YO'Q, lekin bilish kerak:
     LIE — LIED — LIED = yolg'on gapirmoq
     (bu — TO'G'RI fe'l!)


QANDAY YODLASh KERAK:
  1) Guruhlar bo'yicha (A-A-A, A-B-B, A-B-C)
  2) Ovoz chiqarib UCh shaklni birga aytish
  3) Har fe'lni GAP ichida yodlash
  4) Kuniga 5-10 ta fe'l

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: be — cut (19 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
BIRINChI QISM — 19 TA FE'L:

  be      was/were   been      bo'lmoq
  bear    bore       born(e)   tug'moq;
                               ko'tarmoq
  beat    beat       beaten    urmoq; yutmoq
  become  became     become    bo'lmoq
  begin   began      begun     boshlamoq
  bite    bit        bitten    tishlamoq
  blow    blew       blown     puflamoq
  break   broke      broken    sindirmoq
  bring   brought    brought   olib kelmoq
  build   built      built     qurmoq
  burn    burnt      burnt     yonmoq
  burst   burst      burst     yorilmoq
  buy     bought     bought    sotib olmoq
  can     could      (been able to)  ...a olmoq
  catch   caught     caught    ushlamoq
  choose  chose      chosen    tanlamoq
  come    came       come      kelmoq
  cost    cost       cost      turmoq (narx)
  cut     cut        cut       kesmoq


⚠ DIQQAT QILISh KERAK:

  'BE' — 2-shaklda IKKI variant:
     I / he / she / it → WAS
     you / we / they   → WERE
     3-shakl bitta — BEEN

  'BECOME' va 'COME' — 1 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
     become — became — BECOME
     come — came — COME

  'BEAT' — 1 va 2-shakl bir xil:
     beat — BEAT — beaten

  'BURST', 'COST', 'CUT' — uchalasi bir xil.

  'BRING' va 'BUY' — bir xil oxir:
     bring — brought — brought
     buy — bought — bought
     (catch — caught — caught ham shunga
      o'xshash)


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I HAVE BEEN to London.' (borib keldim)
  'She BECAME a doctor.'
  'He has BROKEN his leg.'
  'We BOUGHT some postcards.' (115-bet)
  'It COST 10 pounds.'

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: deal — hurt (29 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKINChI QISM — 29 TA FE'L:

  deal    dealt      dealt     ish yuritmoq
  dig     dug        dug       qazimoq
  do      did        done      qilmoq
  dream   dreamt     dreamt    tush ko'rmoq
  drink   drank      drunk     ichmoq
  drive   drove      driven    haydamoq
  eat     ate        eaten     yemoq
  fall    fell       fallen    yiqilmoq
  feed    fed        fed       boqmoq
  feel    felt       felt      his qilmoq
  fight   fought     fought    jang qilmoq
  find    found      found     topmoq
  flee    fled       fled      qochmoq
  fly     flew       flown     uchmoq
  forbid  forbade    forbidden taqiqlamoq
  forget  forgot     forgotten unutmoq
  forgive forgave    forgiven  kechirmoq
  freeze  froze      frozen    muzlamoq
  get     got        got       olmoq
  give    gave       given     bermoq
  go      went       gone      bormoq
  grow    grew       grown     o'smoq
  hang    hung       hung      osmoq
  have    had        had       ega bo'lmoq
  hear    heard      heard     eshitmoq
  hide    hid        hidden    yashirmoq
  hit     hit        hit       urmoq
  hold    held       held      ushlab turmoq
  hurt    hurt       hurt      og'ritmoq


⚠ DIQQAT QILISh KERAK:

  'GO' — 3-shakl IKKI xil ma'noda:
     'has GONE' = ketdi, HALI u yerda
     'has BEEN' = borib KELDI
     (Unit 15 ning asosiy qoidasi!)

  'HANG' — IKKI xil 2/3-shakl:
     HUNG = osilgan (rasm, kiyim)
     HANGED = osib o'ldirilgan (odam)

  'FORBID' — 'forbidden' 115-betda bor:
     'You mustn't feed the animals — it's
      FORBIDDEN.'

  '-N' bilan tugaydiganlar:
     driven, eaten, fallen, flown, forbidden,
     forgotten, forgiven, frozen, given,
     gone, grown, hidden

  A-B-B guruhi (2 va 3 bir xil):
     dealt, dug, dreamt, fed, felt, fought,
     found, fled, got, had, heard, held

  A-A-A guruhi:
     hit, hurt


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I have EATEN at an Indian restaurant.'
     (115-bet)
  'I nearly FORGOT!' (115-bet)
  'They have GONE to the zoo.' (114-bet)
  'There are things I haven't DONE yet.'
     (115-bet)

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: keep — put (16 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
UChINChI QISM — 16 TA FE'L:

  keep   kept    kept     saqlamoq
  know   knew    known    bilmoq
  lay    laid    laid     qo'ymoq, yotqizmoq
  lead   led     led      boshlab bormoq
  learn  learnt  learnt   o'rganmoq
  leave  left    left     tark etmoq;
                          qoldirmoq
  lend   lent    lent     qarz bermoq
  let    let     let      ruxsat bermoq
  lie    lay     lain     yotmoq
  light  lit     lit      yoqmoq (olov)
  lose   lost    lost     yo'qotmoq
  make   made    made     yasamoq, qilmoq
  mean   meant   meant    anglatmoq
  meet   met     met      uchrashmoq
  pay    paid    paid     to'lamoq
  put    put     put      qo'ymoq


⚠ ENG QIYIN JOY — 'LAY' va 'LIE':

  LAY — LAID — LAID  = qo'ymoq (nimanidir)
     'I LAY the book on the table.'
     'I LAID the book on the table.'

  LIE — LAY — LAIN   = yotmoq (o'zi)
     'I LIE on the bed.'
     'I LAY on the bed yesterday.'

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'LAY' — bir fe'lning 1-shakli,
  boshqa fe'lning 2-shakli!

  ⚠ Jadvalda YO'Q, lekin bilish kerak:
     LIE — LIED — LIED = yolg'on gapirmoq
     (TO'G'RI fe'l!)


⚠ 'LEND' va 'BORROW' FARQI:
  LEND = qarz BERMOQ
     'I LENT him my book.'
  BORROW = qarz OLMOQ
     'I BORROWED his book.'


⚠ 'MEAN' — 'meant' TALAFFUZI:
  mean /miːn/ → meant /ment/
  Yozilishi 'mean+t', talaffuzi o'zgaradi.


⚠ 'LEARN' — ikki shakl:
  LEARNT (Britaniya) / LEARNED (Amerika)


A-B-B guruhi (bu qismda deyarli hammasi):
  kept, laid, led, learnt, left, lent, lit,
  lost, made, meant, met, paid

A-A-A: let, put
A-B-C: know (knew/known), lie (lay/lain)


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I want to KEEP FIT.' (114-bet)
  'You mustn't LIGHT fires.' (114-bet)
  'I want to LOSE some weight.' (115-bet)
  'Did they KNOW about aliens?' (113-bet)

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: read — shut (17 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTINChI QISM — 17 TA FE'L:

  read  /riːd/  read /red/  read /red/  o'qimoq
  ride   rode    ridden   minmoq
  ring   rang    rung     jiringlamoq;
                          qo'ng'iroq qilmoq
  rise   rose    risen    ko'tarilmoq
  run    ran     run      yugurmoq
  say    said    said     aytmoq
  see    saw     seen     ko'rmoq
  seek   sought  sought   izlamoq
  sell   sold    sold     sotmoq
  send   sent    sent     jo'natmoq
  set    set     set      qo'ymoq; botmoq
  sew    sewed   sewn     tikmoq (igna
                          bilan)
  shake  shook   shaken   silkitmoq
  shine  shone   shone    porlamoq
  shoot  shot    shot     otmoq
  show   showed  shown    ko'rsatmoq
  shut   shut    shut     yopmoq


⚠ 'READ' — ENG ALDAMChI FE'L:

  YOZILIShI uchala shaklda BIR XIL: read
  TALAFFUZI esa o'zgaradi:

     1-shakl: read /riːd/  (uzun 'ii')
     2-shakl: read /red/   (qisqa 'e')
     3-shakl: read /red/   (qisqa 'e')

  'I READ /riːd/ books every day.'
  'I READ /red/ a book yesterday.'


⚠ 'RUN' — 1 va 3-shakl BIR XIL:
  run — ran — RUN
  ('come' va 'become' kabi)


⚠ 'SAY' va 'TELL' FARQI:
  SAY something (TO somebody)
     'He SAID hello TO me.'
  TELL somebody something
     'He TOLD me a story.'

  113-bet: 'to TELL jokes' ('say jokes' XATO)


⚠ IKKI ShAKLLI FE'LLAR:
  sew  — sewed — SEWN (SEWED)
  show — showed — SHOWN

  Ikkalasida ham 2-shakl '-ed' bilan,
  3-shakl '-n' bilan.


⚠ 'SHINE' — ikki ma'no:
  shine — shone — shone = porlamoq
  ('shined' — poyabzalni yaltiratmoq
   ma'nosida ishlatiladi)


A-B-C guruhi:
  ride (ridden), ring (rung), rise (risen),
  see (seen), sew (sewn), shake (shaken),
  show (shown), run (ran/run)

A-B-B guruhi:
  said, sought, sold, sent, shone, shot

A-A-A guruhi:
  read (yozilishi), set, shut


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'I RODE a camel.' (104-bet)
  'Have you SENT the invitations yet?'
     (114-bet)
  'they have SEEN UFOs in the area' (113-bet)
  'What do the pictures SHOW?' (113-bet)

exercises.instructionUz: Noto'g'ri fe'llar: sing — write (30 ta fe'l)
exercises.explanationUz:
BEShINChI QISM — 30 TA FE'L:

  sing    sang    sung      kuylamoq
  sit     sat     sat       o'tirmoq
  sleep   slept   slept     uxlamoq
  smell   smelt   smelt     hidlamoq
  speak   spoke   spoken    gapirmoq
  spell   spelt   spelt     harflab aytmoq
  spend   spent   spent     sarflamoq
  split   split   split     bo'lmoq, yormoq
  spread  spread  spread    yoymoq
  spring  sprang  sprung    sakramoq
  stand   stood   stood     turmoq
  steal   stole   stolen    o'g'irlamoq
  stick   stuck   stuck     yopishtirmoq
  sting   stung   stung     chaqmoq (ari)
  stink   stank   stunk     sassiq hid
                            taratmoq
  strike  struck  struck    urmoq
  swear   swore   sworn     qasam ichmoq;
                            so'kinmoq
  sweep   swept   swept     supurmoq
  swim    swam    swum      suzmoq
  take    took    taken     olmoq
  teach   taught  taught    o'rgatmoq
  tear    tore    torn      yirtmoq
  tell    told    told      aytmoq
  think   thought thought   o'ylamoq
  throw   threw   thrown    tashlamoq
  understand understood understood  tushunmoq
  wake    woke    woken     uyg'onmoq
  wear    wore    worn      kiymoq
  win     won     won       yutmoq
  write   wrote   written   yozmoq


⚠ i → a → u GURUHI (juda muntazam!):
  sing   — sang   — sung
  ring   — rang   — rung
  spring — sprang — sprung
  sting  — stung  — stung
  stink  — stank  — stunk
  swim   — swam   — swum
  drink  — drank  — drunk
  begin  — began  — begun

  ⚠ 'sting' va 'stick' 2-shaklda 'a' emas,
  'u' bilan: stung, stuck.


⚠ '-ought' / '-aught' GURUHI:
  think — THOUGHT
  buy — bought, bring — brought,
  fight — fought, seek — sought

  teach — TAUGHT
  catch — caught


⚠ 'TELL' va 'SAY' FARQI:
  TELL somebody something
     'He TOLD me a story.'
  SAY something TO somebody
     'He SAID hello TO me.'

  ⚠ 'tell a joke / a story / the truth / a lie'


⚠ 'TEAR' — TALAFFUZ:
  tear /teə/ = yirtmoq (fe'l)
  tear /tɪə/ = ko'z yoshi (ot)
  Bir xil yoziladi, boshqacha o'qiladi!


⚠ 'WEAR' va 'PUT ON':
  WEAR = kiyib turmoq (HOLAT)
     'She IS WEARING a red dress.'
  PUT ON = kiymoq (HARAKAT)
     'She PUT ON her coat.'

  113-bet: 'The aliens ARE WEARING long
  robes.'


A-B-B guruhi:
  sat, slept, smelt, spent, stood, stuck,
  stung, struck, swept, taught, told,
  thought, understood, won

A-A-A guruhi:
  split, spread

A-B-C guruhi:
  sang/sung, spoke/spoken, sprang/sprung,
  stole/stolen, stank/stunk, swore/sworn,
  swam/swum, took/taken, tore/torn,
  threw/thrown, woke/woken, wore/worn,
  wrote/written


GAP NAMUNALARI:
  'My uncle TOOK me there yesterday.'
     (115-bet)
  'Did they KNOW ...?' / 'I THOUGHT so.'
  'You mustn't THROW bottles into the sea.'
     (114-bet)
  'I have never WRITTEN a letter in English.'

exercises.instructionEn: Irregular Verbs - Infinitive / Past / Past Participle (112 verbs)
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - GRAMMAR BOOK'NING NOTO'G'RI
FE'LLAR JADVALI (68-bet).

  112 ta fe'l, uch ustunda:
     Infinitive - Past - Past Participle


⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM TOPILMA - IKKI JADVAL BIR
XIL EMAS!

  Coursebook'ning 116-betida ham AYNAN
  shunday jadval bor edi. Ikkalasini
  solishtirdik:

     COURSEBOOK 116-bet - 111 ta fe'l
     GRAMMAR   68-bet - 112 ta fe'l

  ⚠ GRAMMAR'DA QO'ShILGAN (3 ta):
     draw  - drew  - drawn
     spill - spilt - spilt
     spoil - spoilt - spoilt

  ⚠ GRAMMAR'DA TUShIB QOLGAN (2 ta):
     flee  - fled  - fled
     stink - stank - stunk

  Ya'ni bitta kitob to'plamining ikki
  jadvali bir-biriga MOS KELMAYDI.

  ⚠ Nima qilish kerak: IKKALA jadvaldagi
  fe'llarni ham o'rganing - jami 114 ta.


UCh USTUN NIMANI ANGLATADI:

  1-USTUN - INFINITIVE (asosiy shakl)
     'I GO to school.'  'Did you GO?'

  2-USTUN - PAST (V2)
     'I WENT yesterday.'

  3-USTUN - PAST PARTICIPLE (V3)
     'I HAVE GONE.'  'It WAS BROKEN.'


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:

  'DID'/'DIDN'T' dan keyin - 1-ShAKL!
     'Did you GO?'   ✓
     'Did you WENT?' ✗

  'HAVE'/'HAS' dan keyin - 3-ShAKL!
     'I have GONE.'  ✓
     'I have WENT.'  ✗


⚠ BU JADVAL QAYSI UNITGA KERAK:

  Mundarija bo'yicha bu jadval 15-unitdan
  KEYIN turadi - chunki Unit 15
  (Present Perfect) da 3-ShAKL kerak
  bo'ladi.

  Unit 10 (Past Simple) da esa 2-ShAKL.


TO'LIQ IZOH QAYERDA:

  Har fe'lning namunalari, guruhlari
  (A-A-A, A-B-B, A-B-C, i-a-u, '-ought')
  va chalkash juftliklari (lie/lay,
  lend/borrow, teach/learn) COURSEBOOK
  116-BETIDA batafsil berilgan.

  Bu yerda esa faqat ro'yxat va
  Grammar'ga XOS uchta yangi fe'l
  izohlanadi.

exercises.explanationUz:

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I go to school. Did you go? I didn't go.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'DID' va 'DIDN'T' dan keyin DOIM 1-SHAKL!
'Did you WENT?' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I went to school yesterday. My uncle took me there.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha maktabga bordim. Amakim meni u yerga olib bordi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE — aniq vaqt bor
(yesterday, last night, on Friday, ago).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I have gone. She has eaten. They have written.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men ketdim. U yedi. Ular yozishdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
PRESENT PERFECT — vaqt aytilmagan.
⚠ 'have went' — XATO, 'have GONE' ✓

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The window was broken. My bike has been stolen.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
3-shakl MAJHUL NISBATDA ham ishlatiladi
(ish kim tomonidan qilingani muhim emas).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They will not be able to understand our technology.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'can' ning kelajagi — 'WILL BE ABLE TO'.
'will can' — XATO (112-bet).
